description: A C_PDU marked DELIVER IN ORDER waits for a missing earlier D_PDU while one without the flag is delivered at once; the retransmitted D_PDU releases both in-order C_PDUs, oldest first.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142): window edges at their initial values (C-0782, C-0787), and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). The peer sent three single-segment C_PDUs in one 4-block transmission: A (FSN 0, DELIVER IN ORDER, TX WIN LWE), B (FSN 1, DELIVER IN ORDER) and C (FSN 2, DELIVER IN ORDER clear, TX WIN UWE). A was lost. B arrives at 61000 (block 1 of 4, EOT 30, end 76000) and C at 66000 (block 2, EOT 20, end 76000). B is complete, but an in-order C_PDU waits until every D_PDU before it has been received, and FSN 0 has not (RX LWE stays 0), so it is held (C-0178, C-1123). C does not ask for order, so it is delivered as soon as it is complete (C-0179): the first DATA C_PDU delivered by ARQ, so cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 stops (B-0215), and the client gets 'cccc'. The burst ends at 72000: csma.vdcd_end to 76000, LBT rule 1, contention 12000 ms. At 88000 the ACK-ONLY: RX LWE 0 (C-0776), RX UWE 2 (C-0778), so one bitmap byte for FSNs 1 and 2, bits 0 and 1 set, padded with zeros (C-0207 to C-0211): 0x03; 16 bytes, one block. At 101000 the peer retransmits A (FSN 0, a 2-block transmission, EOT 20, end 111000). RX LWE moves to 3; A is complete with nothing missing before it and is delivered, then B, whose earlier D_PDUs are now all received: 'aaaa' then 'bbbb', in FSN order (C-0178, C-0516). The burst ends at 102000: csma.vdcd_end to 111000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms, and at 156000 the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 3 and no bitmap. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): no transmission here has room in its last block for a copy of its ACK-ONLY (15 or more bytes) or for a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes), so each is zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
